Mand Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Mánd, Hungary

Demolished. Mánd's Jewish cemetery appears on a cadastral map from 1895, its earliest documented reference. The village's Jewish population was always small and shrinking: 13 residents in 1840, peaking at 15 in 1880, then declining steadily to 11 by 1910, 9 by 1920, 10 by 1930, and just 7 by 1941. According to Yad Vashem records, 8 of Mánd's Jews were murdered in the Holocaust. The cemetery was demolished at an unrecorded time, though the site is currently owned by the local community and its grass is mown regularly.
